Q. 1 فَرْدَسَهُ , (O, K,) inf. n. فَرْدَسَةٌ, (Kr, M, O,) He threw him down, prostrate, on the ground, (Kr, M, O, K,) in an evil, or abominable, manner: (Kr, M, O:) and flung him upon the ground; lit., smote with him the ground. (O, K.) ―
-b2- And فَرْدَسَ الجُلَّةَ He filled, or stuffed, compactly, the [receptacle for dates, termed] جُلَّة. (AA, O, * K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
